newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Cyprus firm can buy shares in Ukraine cement-maker.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus firm can buy shares in Ukraine cement-maker.

text.p: Ukraine's Anti-Monopoly Committee has given Cyprus-registered Bonarco Ltd permission to buy an unspecified number of shares in Ukraine's largest cement maker, a committee statement said on Tuesday.
The ruling also allowed Bonarco and Baltsem, the Kharkiv-based cement maker, to create a new closed company, ZAT Ukrainsky Tsement.

Baltsem is capable of producing four million tonnes of cement annually, but produced only 221,000 tonnes last year because it was not able to make payments for energy and consequently had its power cut off, the statement said.
The committee declined to give any further details about Bonarco.
